## Failure and corrected behavior

Describe the trigger, observed failure, and corrected behavior. Explain the root
cause and how the change addresses it.

## Related issue

Closes #ISSUE or Refs #ISSUE.

## Reproduction and validation

Provide the reproduction and regression evidence with relevant commands and
results. Explain checks not run. Include only sanitized output.

## Limitations

State affected compatibility, untested inputs, or remaining failure cases, or
write None.
